detailsNote: Official annual deadline lacks an explicit calendar year; Fall 2027 deadline not confirmed. Admission model not established by opened sources.

applicationFee.note: Conditional affiliation/service and virtual Open House waivers; no general financial-need waiver. International eligibility must be confirmed. Ask before paying; no retroactive refunds.

english.note: IELTS each band at least 6; PTE 68. Official agency scores within two years of application; no MyBest/IELTS Indicator. Qualifying degree-country/institution or English-instruction plus official-country-language exemption reviewed centrally; English medium alone is not a blanket exemption.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from every institution; official after offer
Original-language records and certified English translations when needed
requirements.note: Statement 250–500 words on objectives, research, goals, qualifications and teaching experience if seeking aid. Prior research correspondence with department faculty required; name contacted faculty and fit. No firm prior lab acceptance requirement established.

funding.note: Generally five funding years; sixth considered individually. Funded students must select a department adviser/co-adviser. No stipend amount or universal international award established.
